idea: Themed weeks, Money day: written from the source, then corrected by two independent editors before voicing.
description: Delhi's 3,981 bank offices held ₹20.7 lakh crore of deposits at end-March 2025: ₹520 crore for each office, the highest of 35 states and Union territories. Maharashtra was next at ₹353 crore; India's figure was ₹140 crore.

Delhi was the highest in each of the last three years (₹439, ₹477 and ₹520 crore). Scheduled commercial banks. A deposit is counted where the bank office is, not where the saver lives. State totals, not per person. The table shows how much, not why.
source: Reserve Bank of India, Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25 (December 2025), Tables 152 and 155: offices of scheduled commercial banks and their deposits, as at end-March 2025. Deposits per office = deposits divided by offices, state by state; India is the ratio of the two all-India rows. A deposit is counted where the bank office is.
